name: ts-idempotent-webhook-guard
description: Zero-dependency TypeScript/Node.js toolkit for concurrent Promise.all webhook idempotency locking with persistent JSONL WAL storage, constant-time HMAC-SHA256 & Stripe replay verification, SSRF-safe HTTPS validation, and cycle-safe secret redaction.
author: Khoa Phan (@khoap1220-hue)
